newsitem.title: USA: Altera says inventories greatly reduced.
newsitem.headline: Altera says inventories greatly reduced.

text.p: Chip maker Altera Corp said that its customers have almost completed the job of using up excess chip inventories and Altera's orders and backlog increased last quarter, especially in September.
President Rodney Smith noted in comments released with Altera's third quarter results that "September in particular was a month for strong orders."
Altera itself reduced its inventory by $11.7 million and said there was a similar reduction among its distributors.
Earlier, Altera reported third quarter earnings of $0.52 a share, up slightly from $0.51 for the third quarter of 1995.
